visualCharacteristics.structure: inline quotation with 5px grey left rule and side padding, italic quote text, attribution below with leading em dash
visualCharacteristics.source: source: 5px #ccc left border, 54px side padding, 16px italic #555 text, 16px attribution with em dash
visualCharacteristics.purpose: body-size statement quote set off with a grey left rule

contentPattern.structure: row 1 is the quotation (one or more paragraphs, a single Quotation richtext field); row 2 is the optional attribution (plain text name and role, Attribution field; the leading em dash is added by CSS)

reuseGuidance: Use for body-size statement quotes (e.g. ministerial statements) set off with a left rule. Use quote-pull for large display pull quotes.
